value.description: A file inside a tool's JSON.

file.description: The document to convert. Its name's extension says what it is: .pdf, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .epub, .html, an image, and the like. Required to start a conversion.

job.description: The job value a call that answered pending returned. Give it, and no file, to collect that conversion.

pageRange.description: Pages to convert, counted from zero, such as 0-5,10. All pages when left out.

maxPages.description: The most pages to convert. It can lower the app's own cap, never raise it.

mode.description: fast, balanced or accurate. It can lower the app's own mode, never raise it.

description: Input of the convert tool: start a conversion with file, or collect one that was still running with job.
